name: Armadex Ex UniCase
removable: Yes (swap the inlay; no recertification for new tablets, per Armadex), but the certificate requires opening only outside the hazardous area and a routine nR test for each new device type
statusNote: New in 2026. Armadex lists it for pre-order and also says it ships from stock; check lead times when ordering.
summary: The Armadex Ex UniCase is a universal restricted-breathing (Ex nR) case for 10- to 11-inch tablets (Galaxy Tab, Surface Go and iPad), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx. It takes a standard tablet from the supported list, so it works with the same apps and device management.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex nR IIC T6 Gc / II 3D Ex tc IIIC T85°C Dc
atex.status: IECEx Current, issue 0 (2026-05-28), checked 2026-10-25; ATEX issue 0 read from certificate scan

iecex.marking: Ex nR IIC T6 Gc / Ex tc IIIC T85°C Dc

safety.conditions: The Ex UniCase may only be opened or closed outside the hazardous area. The USB lid and test port plug must always be mounted in the hazardous area. The device must be protected from high-energy impacts, excessive UV light emission and high electrostatic charge processes. Annex: routine test of IEC 60079-15 cl. 10.3 required for each new type of mobile device installed in an nR housing. Rated data: internal Li-ion 3.7-7.6 V DC; USB for use in non-hazardous areas only; WiFi and Bluetooth; IP64.
safety.peripherals: USB lid and test port plug fitted at all times in the Ex area; USB used outside the Ex area only
safety.certifiedAccessories: Armadex Ex BT-Key-02 Bluetooth keyboard (IECEx KSCP 24.0011X issue 1, 2026-06-18: Ex ic IIC T6 Gc / Ex ic IIIB T85°C Dc, Ta 0°C to +60°C, so dust group IIIB only and not below 0°C) and OZC-3 digital camera (IECEx OBAC 25.0008X issue 1, 2026-06-12) are separate Armadex products; whether they are approved for use with the UniCase is not stated. Samsung and Microsoft hosts are batch 4's.

os.name: iPadOS
os.edition: iPadOS (consumer; no LTSC or enterprise edition)
os.updates: Security updates guaranteed until at least March 2030 (Apple's minimum)

specs.display: 11-inch Liquid Retina IPS LCD, True Tone, fingerprint-resistant oleophobic coating (no antireflective coating or full lamination listed by Apple)
specs.batteryLife: Up to 10 hours web or video on Wi-Fi
specs.docking: USB-C hubs and docks; Smart Connector or magnetic keyboard accessories where the iPad has them. Not usable through sealed Ex cases except the USB-C or Lightning charging port where the case exposes it.
specs.gnss: GPS/GNSS on Wi-Fi + Cellular models; digital compass and Wi-Fi location on all
specs.keys: Top button with Touch ID sensor, volume buttons; no programmable hardware key
specs.pen: Apple Pencil (USB-C), Apple Pencil (1st generation) with adapter
specs.ruggedness: Impact-resistant enclosure and screen (no standard stated)
specs.partNumbers: UC-CASE (case + first inlay set); sets e.g. UC-SET-IPAD-A16-128-WIFI, UC-SET-IPAD-AIR-M3-128-WIFI, UC-SET-IPAD-AIR-M4-128-WIFI, UC-SET-IPAD-PRO-M4-256-WIFI (55 configurations in the catalogue)

throughCase.label: Smart Connector / keyboard
throughCase.value: Bluetooth keyboard only (Armadex Ex BT-Key-02, IECEx KSCP 24.0011X, sold separately); Smart Connector not accessible (inferred)

throughCase.label: Side and volume buttons
throughCase.value: Three stainless steel push buttons via a patented inlay; 'physical buttons fully operable' (device-specific inlay)

throughCase.label: Rear cameras
throughCase.value: Front and rear camera 'supported' through the transparent back plate (maker)

throughCase.label: LiDAR
throughCase.value: Armadex spec table says 'LiDAR: Yes' for iPad Pro M4/M5 and 'No' for A16/Air; whether the LiDAR works through the back plate is not stated

throughCase.label: Front camera
throughCase.value: Supported through the transparent front window (maker)

throughCase.label: Touchscreen
throughCase.value: Touchscreen interaction through the transparent front cover (certificate); Gorilla Glass window on the A16/Air datasheets, polycarbonate on the older Pro datasheet

throughCase.label: Screen cover
throughCase.value: Integral front window (Gorilla Glass or polycarbonate)

throughCase.label: Charging
throughCase.value: USB-C socket with sealing cover; charge only in a non-hazardous area (certificate)

throughCase.label: USB-C port
throughCase.value: USB-C port behind a sealing cover; USB socket only for non-hazardous areas

throughCase.label: SIM card
throughCase.value: No SIM tray exposed; 5G sets rely on eSIM (these iPads are eSIM only)

capabilities.label: Push-to-talk
capabilities.value: Via app (third-party PTT apps over Wi-Fi/cellular; no PTT key; Ex-rated? n/a)

capabilities.label: Barcode scanning
capabilities.value: Via app (camera-based scanning; no scan engine)

capabilities.label: NFC reading
capabilities.value: Not possible (no NFC reader on any iPad)

capabilities.label: 3D scanning / LiDAR
capabilities.value: Depends on the host: iPad Pro M4/M5 have LiDAR (Armadex spec table 'LiDAR: Yes'); through-case function not stated

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (FaceTime, Teams or remote-assist apps; needs camera and audio access through the case)

capabilities.label: Bluetooth gas detectors
capabilities.value: Via app (Bluetooth per host; the certificate lists WiFi and Bluetooth as the wireless interfaces; vendor app; no maker-certified integration listed)
